title: AI代理开始接管桌面与记忆，本地推理继续下沉
opening: 今天榜单被AI代理基础设施占据：一边是让代理直接操作桌面应用的agent-desktop，另一边是给代理装上跨会话记忆的claude-mem。同时，FreeToken和colibri把MoE大模型往个人硬件上推，方向很一致——让代理和模型都更贴近本地。

projects.name: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
projects.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents
projects.readmeExcerpt: agent-desktop Computer use for AI agents: read and operate desktop apps through the OS accessibility tree. A CLI and C library for macOS, Windows and Linux. A snapshot returns JSON with a ref for every element an agent can act on. The agent acts on a ref and snapshots again to check, with no pixel matching; the loop stays in your agent. Every CLI call runs in its own process. Headless calls still prohibit foreground activation and synthesized input. Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads. The optional JEV helper sends screen descriptions to a configured model provider; it is separate from the native CLI. See privacy and data handling. Installation Install on macOS, Windows or Linux with npm: Bun, Yarn and pnpm can install the same package. It includes native binaries and platform helpers for x64 and ARM64. For direct execution without a JavaScript launcher, download the matching native archive from GitHub Releases and keep its helper beside the executable. Official Homebrew and Scoop packages are being submitted; they are not yet available in the default catalogs. The
projects.summary: 用操作系统无障碍树让AI代理读写桌面应用，不靠像素匹配，每次操作后重新快照确认。
projects.problem: 代理通过CLI调用获取元素快照，按ref执行操作再快照验证，循环留在代理侧。局限在于快照、剪贴板和截图可能含隐私内容，需自行隔离日志；JEV辅助功能还会把屏幕描述发给模型提供商。

projects.name: D4Vinci/Scrapling
projects.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev
projects.readmeExcerpt: Effortless Web Scraping for the Modern Web Selection methods · Fetchers · Spiders · Proxy Rotation · CLI · MCP Scrapling is a Python Web Scraping framework that brings fast HTTP requests, stealth browsers, powerful parsing, and concurrent crawling into one library. Scrape static pages, render JavaScript, interact with websites, and extract data from the API calls behind them. Build crawlers with reusable sessions, proxy rotation, automatic retries, pause/resume, and built-in data exports. Use it from Python, the terminal, or your AI agent through its MCP server and Agent Skill. From extracting a few fields to collecting a whole website as clean Markdown, Scrapling covers the full scraping workflow. What you can do with Scrapling - **Fetch & interact**: Fast HTTP requests, stealth browsers, JavaScript rendering, Cloudflare Turnstile/Interstitial handling, persistent sessions, and background API capture. - **Parse & extract**: CSS, XPath, text and regex search, adaptive element tracking, similar-element matching, and clean Markdown output. - **Crawl & export**: Concurrent spiders, proxy rotation, retries, AutoThrottle, pause/resume, streaming, ready
projects.summary: Python爬虫框架把快速HTTP、隐身浏览器、解析和并发爬取塞进一个库，还能通过MCP给AI代理用。
projects.problem: 从单次请求到全站爬取都覆盖，支持Cloudflare Turnstile处理、代理轮换和断点续爬。功能面很宽，但隐身浏览器和反反爬能力在实际站点上的效果仍需按目标站点验证。

projects.name: Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios
projects.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Claude Code Game Studios Turn a single Claude Code session into a full game development studio. 49 agents. 74 skills. One coordinated AI team. Why This Exists Building a game solo with AI is powerful — but a single chat session has no structure. No one stops you from hardcoding magic numbers, skipping design docs, or writing spaghetti code. There's no QA pass, no design review, no one asking "does this actually fit the game's vision?" **Claude Code Game Studios** solves this by giving your AI session the structure of a real studio. Instead of one general-purpose assistant, you get 49 specialized agents organized into a studio hierarchy — directors who guard the vision, department leads who own their domains, and specialists who do the hands-on work. Each agent has defined responsibilities, escalation paths, and quality gates. The result: you still make every decision, but now you have a team that asks the right questions, catches mistakes early, and keeps your project organized from first brainstorm to launch. Table of Contents - What's Included - Studio Hierarchy - Slash Commands - Does it produce games, or documents? - Getting Started - Configuration - Upgrading - Project Structu
projects.summary: 把Claude Code会话改造成49个代理组成的游戏工作室，有总监、部门主管和 specialists，带质量门禁。
projects.problem: 针对单人用AI做游戏时缺乏设计评审和QA的问题，用角色分工和升级路径来补结构。它产出的是流程和文档约束，不是游戏本身；代理数量多，协调开销和提示词维护成本不低。

projects.name: FlashML-org/FreeToken
projects.description: FreeToken brings datacenter-scale model serving to your desktop. Run massive models locally, fast and efficiently.
projects.readmeExcerpt: | Download | Paper | Developer Slack | Community Discord | Community WeChat | Unlock datacenter-class intelligence on the hardware you already own — Run 290B+ frontier MoE models locally on your gaming PC at blistering interactive speeds. About FreeToken is an edge-native Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) serving engine designed for running frontier-scale open-weight models on personal and consumer hardware. It treats heterogeneous edge resources—GPUs, CPUs, host memory, and interconnects—as a unified, elastic inference platform. projects.summary: 面向消费硬件的MoE推理引擎，把GPU、CPU和主机内存当成统一弹性平台，在游戏PC上跑290B+模型。
projects.problem: 核心是带宽自适应CPU-GPU协同、专家缓存和语义感知KV缓存，减少代理上下文编辑后的重复计算。实际速度取决于内存带宽和磁盘，消费级硬件上跑前沿模型仍是工程折衷。

projects.name: pingdotgg/t3code

If they're set up on your computer, T3 Code can control them. "Wait, what are you selling me?" Nothing. We built T3 Code because we wanted the best possible development experience with agents. We were inspired by existing solutions like the Codex desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass, but none met our bar. We wanted something performant, remote-ready, and truly open. If we ever go the wrong direction, we want you to have everything you need to fork and build the editor that you want. projects.name: shiyu-coder/Kronos
projects.description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
projects.readmeExcerpt: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets Deutsch | Español | Français | 日本語 | 한국어 | Português | Русский | 中文 > Kronos is the **first open-source foundation model** for financial candlesticks (K-lines), > trained on data from over **45 global exchanges**. 📰 News * 🚩 **[2025.11.10]** Kronos has been accpeted by AAAI 2026. * 🚩 **[2025.08.17]** We have released the scripts for fine-tuning! Check them out to adapt Kronos to your own tasks. * 🚩 **[2025.08.02]** Our paper is now available on arXiv! 📜 Introduction **Kronos** is a family of decoder-only foundation models, pre-trained specifically for the "language" of financial markets—K-line sequences. Unlike general-purpose TSFMs, Kronos is designed to handle the unique, high-noise characteristics of financial data. It leverages a novel two-stage framework: 1. A specialized tokenizer first quantizes continuous, multi-dimensional K-line data (OHLCV) into **hierarchical discrete tokens**. 2. A large, autoregressive Transformer is then pre-trained on these tokens, enabling it to serve as a unified model for diverse quantitative tasks. ✨ Live Demo We have set up a live demo to visualize Kronos's forecasting result
projects.summary: 首个开源的金融K线基础模型，用分层离散tokenizer加自回归Transformer处理OHLCV序列。
projects.problem: 针对金融数据高噪声特点设计，训练数据来自45+全球交易所，已被AAAI 2026接收。适合量化研究做预训练和微调起点，但金融预测本身的高风险不会因为模型开源而降低。

Built on top of PyTorch, Kornia integrates seamlessly into existing AI workflows, allowing you to leverage powerful batch transformations, auto-differentiation and GPU acceleration. Whether you're working on image transformations, augmentations, or AI-driven image processing, Kornia equips you with the tools you need to bring your ideas to life. > **📢 Direction**: Kornia is becoming the **reference implementation and executable specification** for differentiable computer vision and geometry in the PyTorch ecosystem — explicit conventions, conformance tests, and honest benchmarks over API growth. Read the Roadmap. projects.problem: 当手写几何变换或RANSAC变得冗长脆弱时，Kornia提供GPU加速的批量实现。它正在转向可执行规范和一致性测试，API增长放缓，对追求稳定接口的生产项目是好事。

projects.name: JustVugg/colibri
projects.description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
projects.readmeExcerpt: Website · Discord · English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · Italiano · 日本語 · Bahasa Indonesia · Português (Brasil) **Tiny engine, immense model.** colibri runs very large open models on the machine you already have. A mixture-of-experts model of hundreds of billions of parameters uses only a small part of itself for each token, so colibri keeps that part in RAM and reads the rest, the experts, from the disk when the model asks for them. Pure C, one file per model family, no GPU required. Thirteen engines run today. Ten are for language models: **GLM-5.2/5.3** (which also runs **Mistral-Large-4**), **GLM-5.3-Flash**, **Inkling**, **Kimi K3**, **DeepSeek V4 Flash**, **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash**, **MiMo-V2.6 Flash** (and Pro), **Qwen3.8-Flash-Next**, **Qwen3.6** (which also runs Qwen3-Coder, the dense Qwen3.8-27B, **Flint**, **Muse Spark Open** and **LFM3-VL**) and **OLMoE**. One draws pictures: **Qwen-Image-2.1**. Two answer decisions: **Laya** and **GLiNER2.5-Decide**, with a third decision model, **Clef**, on the Qwen3.6 engine. projects.summary: 纯C、零依赖的MoE推理引擎，专家权重放磁盘按需流式读取，让大模型在普通机器上跑起来。
projects.problem: 利用MoE每token只激活小部分专家的特性，把其余专家留在磁盘，不需要GPU。支持GGUF直接读取和Vulkan/CUDA后端，但磁盘I/O会成为瓶颈，交互速度取决于存储和内存带宽。

closing: 代理的记忆、操作界面和本地推理引擎正在同时成熟，今天这几个项目拼在一起，已经能看出个人AI工作站的雏形。值得先试agent-desktop和colibri，一个管操作，一个管模型落地。
